name: created_at
description: UTC time the row was written; the newest row per (business_date, incident_id) is the finding

name: status
description: open | dismissed | resolved (a person) | cleared (the watcher: no longer in the triage)

name: runbook
description: The runbook entry that matched, if any

name: cause
description: The likely cause, or that the evidence does not establish one

name: established
description: True when code judged that the evidence establishes a cause

name: do_now
description: The investigation's one thing to do now

name: action
description: The proposed action (rerun, wait, escalate, ...) — a proposal, never carried out by the watcher

name: timeline
description: JSON list of the first evidence timeline items {time, source, text}

name: model
description: Model that wrote the answer; empty for the model-free summary

name: fallback
description: True when the answer is the model-free summary

name: notified
description: True when Backstage accepted the notification

name: actor
description: watcher, or the verified person who changed the status
